description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of four different decoding strategies—RPG (CodeLlama-7B), Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), RPG (CodeLlama-34B), and RPG (CodeLlama-7B)—across four distinct metrics: EGP ↑, TR-N ↓, TR-S ↓, and CCP ↑. The horizontal axis, labeled “Metrics,” displays these four categories in left-to-right order, each marked with an upward or downward arrow indicating whether higher or lower values are preferable for that metric. The vertical axis, labeled “Performance,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale. A legend in the top right corner assigns each strategy a color: blue for RPG (CodeLlama-7B), orange for RPG (CodeLlama-7B), green for Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and brown for RPG (CodeLlama-34B). In the EGP ↑ group, the brown bar (RPG (CodeLlama-34B)) reaches approximately 1.0, the orange bar (RPG (CodeLlama-7B)) is slightly below 1.0, the green bar (Greedy (CodeLlama-34B)) is at approximately 0.6, and the blue bar (RPG (CodeLlama-7B)) is near zero. In the TR-N ↓ group, the blue bar reaches approximately 0.7, the orange bar is at approximately 0.45, the green bar is at approximately 0.6, and the brown bar is at approximately 0.4. In the TR-S ↓ group, the blue bar reaches approximately 0.7, the orange bar is at approximately 0.4, the green bar is at approximately 0.45, and the brown bar is at approximately 0.3. In the CCP ↑ group, the blue bar reaches approximately 0.4, the orange bar is at approximately 0.7, the green bar is at approximately 0.7, and the brown bar is at approximately 0.9. The bars are grouped by metric, with each group containing one bar for each strategy, and are not sorted by value.
